title: Standalone Practice
theme: Drill focus: rotate through stations, then workshop defensive plays.

blocks.title: Dynamic Warmup
blocks.notes: Pick 2-3; flow continuously.

blocks.title: Throwing Drills
blocks.notes: Pair off; partners 10-30ft based on drill.

blocks.title: Stations 1 (3 stations × ~4min + rotations)
blocks.notes: Rotation drop: outfield. 4 kids per station, coach per station.

blocks.title: Stations 2 (3 stations × ~4min + rotations)
blocks.notes: Rotate kids through. Same coach assignments as Stations 1.

blocks.title: Situational Baseball + Defensive Plays Workshop
defensive_plays: Cut-off and relay from the outfield (single in the gap)
Force play at 2B (runner on 1B, ground ball to SS)
Tag play at home (outfielder fielding a single with runner on 2B)
blocks.notes: Workshop these 2-3 plays in live situational reps. Keep moving — quality reps over volume.
